BQ.finding: Warenwet BES article 2(1) excludes manufacture within the same private household, not purchased-food import generally. Article3(1)(j)–(k) empowers implementing import/export and registration rules; it does not itself impose a universal imported-food origin certificate. Article3(4) allows rules for particular BES islands. Read current official indexed 2023 text and FAOLEX 2023 full-text copy. No material new common three-island personal postal food exemption or mandatory certificate found. Existing manufactured-tea/island-specific implementing-rule gap remains.
